titles.romaji: Da Wei Bei Ken Zhi Daomei Tegong Xiong
titles.native: 大卫贝肯之倒霉特工熊

description:
A Chinese adaptation of the international Backkom franchise.

The film tells of Backoom the immortal bear taking a chance to accept training to be a secret agent (like James Bond) which he goes on an adventure and saves the world.
